details.how_it_works: ShipTrail is a top_level MeshInstance3D (world space, so it does not inherit ship yaw or the MODEL_YAW_DEG pivot), additive unshaded, no collision, not pickable. Player trail is sampled in update_from only while not paused and state is flying, and is hidden and cleared when the ship is not in the viewed system. Rival trails are fed from advance(), which only runs while the game runs. Trail fades out when the ship stops. The no-model cone fallback is scaled too.
